lines.text: This coat costs an arm and a leg.

data.define: Used when something costs a huge amount of money.

example.text: This coat costs an arm and a leg.

misuse.text: Don't take 'an arm and a leg' literally at the store.

data.l1_ex: هذا المعطف يكلف "an arm and a leg".

native.tip: “arm and a leg” = مبلغ باهظ جداً. مثال: “This coat costs an arm and a leg.”
